candidate.title: PAL-Seq
candidate.scope: The single PAL-Seq (poly(A)-tail length profiling by sequencing) workflow in the assigned Illumina schematic, interpreted with the Subtelny et al. primary implementation. The image depicts one linear RNA-to-cDNA-to-flow-cell route and a paired sequence/fluorescence readout. Differently sized surface molecules illustrate tail lengths, not alternative methods. The verified collection page has the matching PAL-Seq heading and schematic caption. 3P-Seq is a library-preparation comparison in the catalogue, and PAT-seq is a related citation; neither is an additional depicted target. Unshown purification routines, application-specific variants and analysis settings are outside scope.
